description: Verify that TCP in CW / CLOSING / LAST-ACK does not change state after receiving a FIN+ACK (RFC 793 §3.9 p75). 3 iterations exercise wst ∈ {CW with valid ack, CLOSING with invalid ack, LA with invalid ack}
approach:
[Objective]
Late-state FIN+ACK retransmissions are common; DUT must absorb without state oscillation. RFC 793 §3.9 requires no transition in CW/CLOSING/LA on duplicate FIN+ACK.

[Scenario — chronological]
3 iterations, one per state. Each: drive DUT to wst, tester sends dup FIN+ACK, DUT must remain in wst (no spurious RST or state change).

[Pass condition]
All 3 phases preserve wst.

[Fail condition]
Per phase: prelude failure or Fail_p<n>_unexpected_state_change.

verdicts.Pass: DUT preserved state on dup FIN+ACK — normal
verdicts.Fail_p1_no_handshake_ack: No DUT handshake ACK phase 1 CW
verdicts.Fail_p1_no_close_wait_ack: No DUT close-wait ACK phase 1 CW
verdicts.Fail_p1_unexpected_state_change: DUT state changed after dup FIN+ACK in CW
verdicts.Fail_p2_no_handshake_ack: No DUT handshake ACK phase 2 CLOSING
verdicts.Fail_p2_no_closing_ack: No DUT closing ACK phase 2 CLOSING
verdicts.Fail_p2_unexpected_state_change: DUT emitted RST after dup FIN+ACK in CLOSING
verdicts.Fail_p3_no_handshake_ack: No DUT handshake ACK phase 3 LA
verdicts.Fail_p3_no_close_wait_ack: No DUT close-wait ACK phase 3 LA
verdicts.Fail_p3_unexpected_state_change: DUT emitted RST after dup FIN+ACK in LA
